004551: // The last local this token names, for the four sites whose token has no
004552: // resolved entity. A resolved global must never select a same-named local
004553: // from a scope that has ended.  All four ran a string_equal per
004554: // row: 24.940 fallbacks over 2,32 M rows on a self-compile, which is where the
004555: // lowering's 2,3 M memcmp calls came from, and string_equal is the worst
004556: // L1d-miss-per-cycle ratio of any ordinary symbol in the compile.  The intern
004557: // table is injective and both sides read the one spelling space, so two
004558: // nonzero symbols answer exactly what the two spellings answer; a row or token
004559: // the intern pass never saw still compares spellings, so a missed path costs
004560: // speed and never correctness.
004561: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIntegerIrLocal* c_ir_find_local_by_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token)
004562: {
004563:     CIntegerIrLocal* result = 0;
004564:     // Local rows and symbol rows are allocated together by c_lower_to_ir.
004565:     BUSTER_CHECK(!builder->local_count || (builder->locals && builder->local_symbols));
004566:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
004567:     for (u32 index = builder->local_count; index != 0 && !result; index -= 1)
004568:     {
004569:         u32 candidate_symbol = builder->local_symbols[index - 1];
004570:         bool same = token.symbol && candidate_symbol ? token.symbol == candidate_symbol : string_equal(builder->locals[index - 1].name, spelling);
004571:         if (same)
004572:         {
004573:             result = builder->locals + index - 1;
004574:         }
004575:     }
004576:     return result;
004577: }

004579: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CEntityId c_ir_identifier_entity(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index)
004580: {
004581:     CEntityId result;
004582:     if (!builder->token_entities_plus_one || token_index >= builder->preprocess.token_count)
004583:     {
004584:         result = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
004585:     }
004586:     else
004587:     {
004588:         result = (CEntityId){.value = builder->token_entities_plus_one[token_index] - 1};
004589:     }
004590: 
004591:     return result;
004592: }

004594: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CEntityId c_ir_identifier_entity_or_lookup(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 token_index)
004595: {
004596:     CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, token_index);
004597:     if (entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && token_index < builder->preprocess.token_count && builder->parse.scope_count &&
004598:         builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
004599:     {
004600:         entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(&builder->parse, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, (CScopeId){.value = 0}, &builder->preprocess.tokens[token_index]);
004601:     }
004602:     return entity;
004603: }

004605: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end);
004606: 
004607: // May the parenthesized group opening at `open` spell a type name?  False
004608: // only when the token after the `(` proves it cannot, without entering the
004609: // query machine.  c_ir_type_name_prefix accepts a type name that begins with
004610: // a type, qualifier, tag, typeof or _Atomic keyword, a decoration
004611: // c_ir_primitive_type_kind steps over (an attribute, an asm label, a `[[`
004612: // attribute) or an identifier naming a typedef, and nothing else, so:
004613: // - a number, a string, a character and every punctuator but `[` is refused
004614: //   outright;
004615: // - an identifier the parser bound to a local, object, parameter,
004616: //   enumerator or function is refused too: the prefix reads that binding
004617: //   before any scope lookup, and none of them is a typedef.  Its spelling
004618: //   must not be one of the keywords above, which
004619: //   c_parse_type_name_start_word_token answers from the word bits (an
004620: //   interned spelling outside the predefined range is no keyword; symbol 0
004621: //   is unclassified and stays a candidate).
004622: // An unbound identifier keeps the scope-chain lookup the probe does for it,
004623: // and a typedef is the candidate the probe exists for.
004624: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open)
004625: {
004626:     bool result = true;
004627:     if (open + 1 < builder->preprocess.token_count)
004628:     {
004629:         CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
004630:         if (first.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
004631:         {
004632:             result = first.punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET;
004633:         }
004634:         else if (first.symbol && !c_parse_type_name_start_word_token(builder->preprocess, first))
004635:         {
004636:             CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1);
004637:             if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
004638:             {
004639:                 CEntityKind kind = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind;
004640:                 result = kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL && kind != C_ENTITY_OBJECT && kind != C_ENTITY_PARAMETER && kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR &&
004641:                          kind != C_ENTITY_FUNCTION;
004642:             }
004643:         }
004644:     }
004645:     return result;
004646: }
004647: 
004648: // The memo slot for the group opening at `open`, in the body-token array
004649: // prepared_call_indices also spans: a `(` outside the body -- a parameter
004650: // bound's declarator, a global initializer -- has none and is probed each
004651: // time.
004652: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32* c_ir_group_type_name_slot(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open)
004653: {
004654:     u32* slot = 0;
004655:     if (builder->group_type_names && open >= builder->body_token_start && open - builder->body_token_start < builder->body_token_count)
004656:     {
004657:         slot = builder->group_type_names + (open - builder->body_token_start);
004658:     }
004659:     return slot;
004660: }
004661: 
004662: // Whether a probe's answer for the group `open .. close` may be stored.  A
004663: // group headed by typeof/__typeof__/__typeof/typeof_unqual reads the locals
004664: // declared so far, so its answer can change between two probes; a lone
004665: // identifier the parser left unbound is looked up at file scope by
004666: // c_ir_type_name and at the declaration's scope by the query, so the two
004667: // probe paths may not share one answer for it.  Everything else is a
004668: // function of the tokens and the parse alone.
004669: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close)
004670: {
004671:     bool result = true;
004672:     CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
004673:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
004674:     {
004675:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, first);
004676:         if (string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof")) ||
004677:             string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))
004678:         {
004679:             result = false;
004680:         }
004681:         else if (close == open + 2 && c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1).value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
004682:         {
004683:             result = false;
004684:         }
004685:     }
004686:     return result;
004687: }

004689: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_ir_group_type_name_encode(IrTypeId type)
004690: {
004691:     return type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? 1 : type.value + 2;
004692: }

004694: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_group_type_name_decode(u32 encoded)
004695: {
004696:     IrTypeId result;
004697:     if (encoded == 1)
004698:     {
004699:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
004700:     }
004701:     else
004702:     {
004703:         result = (IrTypeId){.value = encoded - 2};
004704:     }
004705:     return result;
004706: }

004708: // The type name the group `open .. close` (a `(` and its matching `)`)
004709: // spells, or invalid: c_ir_type_name over the interior, asked once per
004710: // opener.  The gate refuses the groups that cannot be one before the query
004711: // machine runs, and the memo answers the second and third probe of one `(`
004712: // -- the expression steps, the unary-end scan and the call preparer each ask
004713: // -- so the probe itself, unchanged, stays the reference for both.
004714: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_group_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close)
004715: {
004716:     IrTypeId result;
004717:     u32* slot = c_ir_group_type_name_slot(builder, open);
004718:     if (slot && *slot)
004719:     {
004720:         result = c_ir_group_type_name_decode(*slot);
004721:     }
004722:     else if (!c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(builder, open))
004723:     {
004724:         result = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
004725:         if (slot)
004726:         {
004727:             *slot = 1;
004728:         }
004729:     }
004730:     else
004731:     {
004732:         result = c_ir_type_name(builder, open + 1, close);
004733:         if (slot && c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(builder, open, close))
004734:         {
004735:             *slot = c_ir_group_type_name_encode(result);
004736:         }
004737:     }
004738:     return result;
004739: }
004740: 
004741: // c_ir_query_type_name over the same group, for callers that run inside the
004742: // query machine: the gate and the memo answer without raising a request, and
004743: // a request the probe raises passes through unanswered -- has_request set,
004744: // type_out untouched -- exactly as before.
004745: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_query_group_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close, IrTypeId* type_out)
004746: {
004747:     bool resolved;
004748:     u32* slot = c_ir_group_type_name_slot(builder, open);
004749:     if (slot && *slot)
004750:     {
004751:         *type_out = c_ir_group_type_name_decode(*slot);
004752:         resolved = type_out->value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
004753:     }
004754:     else if (!c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(builder, open))
004755:     {
004756:         *type_out = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
004757:         resolved = false;
004758:         if (slot)
004759:         {
004760:             *slot = 1;
004761:         }
004762:     }
004763:     else
004764:     {
004765:         resolved = c_ir_query_type_name(builder, open + 1, close, true, type_out);
004766:         if (!builder->queries->has_request && slot && c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(builder, open, close))
004767:         {
004768:             *slot = c_ir_group_type_name_encode(*type_out);
004769:         }
004770:     }
004771:     return resolved;
004772: }
